title: Modbus register address offset by one or wrong
summary: Modbus communication works (no timeout, no exception) but the value is wrong or constant: the PLC reads the wrong register.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Modbus communication works (no timeout, no exception) but the value is wrong or constant: the PLC reads the wrong register.

symptoms: Communication status OK, value constant or nonsensical
Value of a neighboring register appears
diagnosticMethod: Compare the device's register map (and whether it uses 0-based or 40001 notation) with the client configuration
Check data type and word order for 32-bit values
repair: Correct the register address or offset
Verify against a known process value
troubleshooting.explanation: Modbus addresses on the wire are zero-based; register 40001 in documentation is address 0. Off-by-one errors produce valid responses with the wrong data.
